suites.name: JDP-I Q
suites.title: Geopolitical Intelligence
suites.description: Monitor events, headlines, volatility and country conditions around the world.

modules.name: Briefing
modules.description: Follow selected topics through publisher headlines and political-perspective filters.

modules.name: Realtime Calendar
modules.description: Upcoming elections plus the last six months of new leaders, coups, outbreaks of war, assassinations, crises and treaties. Month or year view, any country or just the ones you highlight.

modules.name: Global Headline Tracker
modules.description: Pick a country for its 24-hour news feed, or browse daily, weekly and monthly archives.

modules.name: Geopolitical Volatility
modules.description: Compare source-derived country volatility across day, week, month and longer windows.

modules.name: Country PESTLE
modules.description: Daily country analysis across political, economic, social, technological, legal and environmental factors.

modules.name: Realtime Battlefield
modules.description: Every armed conflict this year, grouped into wars, with plain-English briefings, a monthly archive and related coverage. UCDP data, refreshed monthly.

suites.name: JDP-I H&P
suites.title: History & Politics
suites.description: Political systems, leadership and their history.

modules.name: Encyclopaedia
modules.description: Every person, place, war, party and idea in JDP-I. Filter with Boolean tag queries (e.g. Realist + American + "Political science"), and jump to everywhere each one appears across the suite.

modules.name: Political Atlas
modules.description: Who holds power across 78 countries: executives, legislatures, courts, elections, policies and challenges. Refreshed monthly.

modules.name: H&P Retrospective
modules.description: Move a slider from 1926 to today: historical borders, who was in charge of each country, and the key political events of every year, with Wikipedia links.

modules.name: Historical Calendar
modules.description: Political history from 1980 to today in one calendar: elections, new leaders, coups, wars, assassinations, crises and treaties, each with a plain-English account.

modules.name: Retrospective Battlefield
modules.description: Move a slider from 1926 to 2025 to see every war and armed conflict on a historical map, with sides, intensity and Wikipedia links.

modules.name: Kardashev Tracker
modules.description: Which empires and countries controlled what share of humanity's energy capture from 2000 BC to today, after Ian Morris, with humanity's Kardashev rating century by century.

modules.name: Learning
modules.description: The political spectrum through its leaders and thinkers: far left, left, centre, right (Mearsheimer and the Realists) and far right, with quizzes.

modules.name: Double Signal
modules.description: Emails you when a US-listed stock more than doubles in under six hours. Scans the whole market hourly on Cloudflare Workers; private, behind Cloudflare Access.

modules.name: Trader Tracker
modules.description: What members of Congress (including Nancy Pelosi) and famous investors such as Buffett, Burry and Ackman are buying and selling, from STOCK Act and SEC 13F filings. Refreshed weekly.

modules.name: Learning
modules.description: Two courses: Finance, a university-style introduction with worked examples and quizzes, and Economics, taught through Smith, Marx, Keynes, Mises, Friedman and Werner.
